verdict.rationale: OpenAI's official repo ships Whisper as a locally installable package (`pip install -U openai-whisper`), with a local CLI and a Python API (`whisper.load_model`, `transcribe`, `detect_language`, `decode`) and six downloadable model sizes, so the core model runs entirely on the user's own hardware. Hands-on reports confirm local runs on CPU and GPU, though larger models are slow without a CUDA GPU. Missing for 10: a first-party self-hosted server/API mode (the repo offers only a library and CLI), documented hardware requirements, and licensing terms in the evidence.
